thread.title: J.C. Penney’s next CEO should excel in this area, experts say

author: Tonya Garcia
title: J.C. Penney’s next CEO should excel in this area, experts say
text:
Now that the search is on for a new chief executive at J.C. Penney Co. Inc., there’s one area that experts say the new head of the beleaguered retailer should have mastered: marketing.
J.C. Penney JCP, -6.00% announced Tuesday that it is now searching for a successor to Marvin Ellison, who is leaving to become the chief executive of Lowe’s Cos. Inc. LOW, -1.88% , sending shares down roughly 7%.
“Marketing will be paramount in this circumstance,” said Larry Perkins, founding partner at SierraConstellation Partners, a financial advisory and turnaround firm. “Getting bodies through the doors and clicking on website,” including through partnerships, is of greatest importance for J.C. Penney — and many other retailers — at this point.
The retailer reported first-quarter earnings last Thursday that fell short of expectations, with weather taking a lot of the blame. J.C. Penney stock closed that day down 12.4%.
See: This is the one retail category that doesn’t have too many stores
Despite some glimmers of hope in recent quarters, including positive response to the Sephora additions to J.C. Penney stores and new celebrity partnerships and merchandise categories, shares are still down by more than 49% for the last year.
The S&P 500 index SPX, -0.31% is up 14.1% for the past 12 months, and the SPDR S&P Retail ETF XRT, -1.75% is up 11.3% for the period.
“We are lowering our fiscal 2018 and fiscal 2019 estimates as it remains to be seen when J.C. Penney will be able to correct its women’s apparel offering, its largest business segment, which has outweighed encouraging results in the newer initiatives the company has rolled out over the last year,” wrote Susquehanna Financial Group analysts in a note published Friday.
While being mindful of costs is always important, keeping traffic flowing through the doors is more pressing than other issues, like “getting the last dollar out of the inventory,” SierraConstellations Perkins said.
“Pricing and marketing skills” are also on Cowen analysts’ list of recommended qualities, since there is a need for “leveraging coupons in a customer-appropriate manner.”

Other skills and qualities on Cowen’s wish list include an understanding of e-commerce and customer loyalty programs, and experience with apparel.
They think it will take at least five to six months to fill the position.
“We are cautious because in our view securing new retail talent is exceptionally difficult, particularly in the apparel and department store industry given an unexciting need for store closures, difficulty in obtaining sustainable physical store traffic growth, and long-term apparel deflation,” the note said.
Analysts think whoever takes the position will “continue its existing strategy,” which includes a focus on appliances, beauty and services.
SierraConstellations’ Perkins agrees.
“Stabilizing the business model is probably the most important thing he did,” he said, referring to Ellison. “Recent experience indicates that they probably want a little more of the same. They tried to shake things up with [former Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.19% executive] Ron Johnson, and that didn’t work too well.”
Cowen rates J.C. Penney shares market perform with a $3 price target.
